points.description: States the core idea: break the problem into smaller subproblems, solve those subproblems (recursively), and combine their solutions into a solution to the original problem.
points.partial_credit: Half or more of the idea is given, e.g. only divide into subproblems and solve them, with no combining step, or a vague statement of the steps (about 2 marks).

points.description: Mentions that the subproblems are solved recursively (the same method is applied to the smaller subproblems).
points.partial_credit: Only implies repeated solving of subproblems without saying recursion or the same method (0.5).

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating divide into smaller subproblems, solve them, and combine the results, in any wording. Give part marks if the combine step is missing or the steps are vague. Give no marks for naming examples such as merge sort without describing the paradigm.
